title: LF for AI tools for Game Development
author: Sama_GP
selftext:
Hello my fellow AI Game Devs, I hope you are building a great game. 

I am looking for some good AI tools for game design & development, something which can help me to build a side scroller game like: Prince of Persia Lost Crown,  Hollow Knight,  Castlevania Balmont Curse etc

I don't know what sorts of AI tools can help me with bcos my main department is marketing. I have a small team who are interested in using AI tools for Game building. 

Some of them have basic knowledge of Unity & Unreal Engine but their coding skills is not good

So Help me with AI tools recommendations or suggestions which can bring my game to life with minimum technical knowledge, if possible.

comments.author: Expensive-Tomato-311
comments.body:
If your team's coding skills are light, your best bet is leaning heavily into AI-assisted tools and visual game builders to get a prototype moving.

Aside from standard asset generators, if you're looking at environment and world design specifically, I'm actually building an early-stage tool called **Forge.** it is currently in the very early stages of development currently building a prototype. For early access to the beta version join the waitlist( [elltechs.com](http://elltechs.com) ) that lets developers describe a 3D environment in natural language to generate explorable spaces rather than building them piece by piece. For 2D side-scrollers specifically, you might also look at platforms like Rosebud AI for browser-based prototyping.

The biggest advice for a non-coding team is to keep the initial scope microscopic—get one character moving through a single well-designed scene before worrying about complex mechanics!"
